# AICR v0.20.0 EKS H100 training configuration

NVIDIA AICR selected an EKS H100 training platform. This entry keeps the exact source choices, 17 generated Argo CD Applications, lifecycle plan, and public OCI digests together.

This README accompanies the retained Catalog base and is ready for the future ConfigHub Space. The links below work now; the ConfigHub base and derived variants have not been created yet.

## Why this example exists

AICR chooses and orders the platform, but a team still needs one checked starting configuration that connects those choices to the exact files it will review.

This entry provides that base without claiming that ConfigHub, Argo CD, EKS, or an H100 workload has already used it. Later environment variants can start from the recorded base instead of repeating the source investigation.

## What this example shows

- The provider-curated source variant combines EKS, H100, Ubuntu, Kubeflow, and training into 15 ordered components.
- AICR generates an app-of-apps Helm chart, and Helm renders the wrapper into one parent Application and 16 component Applications.
- The source package and the 17 exact Applications are separate public OCI artifacts. Both pull without registry credentials and match the retained bytes.
- The route intent names ordering, CRDs, hooks, setup work, target facts, and AICR checks that still need destination-specific handling.
- The field-policy assessment separates source-controlled choices from fields that may become reviewed ConfigHub changes.

## Where each setting comes from

| Place | What this Space records |
| --- | --- |
| Starting configuration | NVIDIA's source catalog selects `h100-eks-ubuntu-training-kubeflow` from the requested service, accelerator, operating system, workload, and platform. |
| ConfigHub changes | No v0.20.0 ConfigHub change exists yet. The retained 17-Application base is the proposed upload input; development and staging changes will be recorded separately. |
| Install work | The route intent records Argo CD, target matching, sync-wave ordering, nested chart lifecycle work, node inspection, and source-aware validation. |
| Live cluster | No EKS or H100 target was contacted. Storage, GPU, EFA/RDMA, driver, and controller facts must be checked for the selected destination. |

If an upstream change and a local ConfigHub revision touch the same field, review the overlap before promotion.

- The 17 Application objects are exact, but 16 Applications still point at sources that Argo CD renders later.
- ConfigHub base upload, derived variants, promotion, release OCI, Argo CD or Flux delivery, EKS execution, H100 runtime, and rollback have not run for v0.20.0.
